Best value under ₹50,000 from the Smartprix list updated Thu 22 Oct 2026:

MSI Modern 14: ₹43,219 Ryzen 5 7530U, 16GB memory, 512GB storage. Most power for the price.
Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 1: ₹37,990 Ryzen 5 5500U, 8GB memory, 512GB storage. Cheaper, but older and has less memory.
Dell 15 DC15250: ₹36,994 Intel Core 3 100U, 8GB memory, 512GB storage. Lowest price, lightest performance.

The Honor MagicBook X14 Pro (₹42,999 Core i5, 16GB) looks stronger but is listed as upcoming. These are list prices, so check the store before buying.
